zh: 俄亥俄州立大学（The Ohio State University，简称OSU）成立于1870年，位于美国俄亥俄州首府哥伦布市，是美国最大的公立研究型大学之一，北美学术联盟美国大学协会（AAU）最早加入（1916年）的成员之一及十大联盟成员，被誉为公立常春藤（Public Ivy）。在2026年QS世界大学排名中位列全球第190位，相较于2025年的第208位，排名跃升18位。学校主校区占地面积1764英亩，共有210栋建筑，其中46栋为学生宿舍。
en: The Ohio State University (OSU), founded in 1870, is located in Columbus, the capital of Ohio, USA. It is one of the largest public research universities in the United States, an early member (1916) of the Association of American Universities (AAU), and a member of the Big Ten Conference, known as a "Public Ivy". Ranked 190th in the QS World University Rankings 2026, it jumped 18 places from 208th in 2025. The main campus covers 1,764 acres with 210 buildings, including 46 student dormitories.
